definitions.explanation: A person who writes books, articles, or other written works.
A person who creates artistic works such as manga, plays, or other creative works.

examples.japanese: この{小説|しょうせつ}の{作者|さくしゃ}は{誰|だれ}ですか。
examples.english: Who is the author of this novel?

examples.japanese: {作者|さくしゃ}{不明|ふめい}の{作品|さくひん}だ。
examples.english: It is a work by an unknown author.

examples.japanese: {漫画|まんが}の{作者|さくしゃ}に{会|あ}いたい。
examples.english: I want to meet the manga artist.

notes:
RELATED TERMS:
・{著者|ちょしゃ} - author (more formal, typically for non-fiction)
・{作家|さっか} - writer, author (profession)
・{原作者|げんさくしゃ} - original author

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{作者|さくしゃ}{不明|ふめい} (author unknown)
・{原|げん}{作者|さくしゃ} (original author/creator)
